authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states from live G03 v4 exactByteIntent and noLoadProtocol. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a D-006 unit. It does not invent a machine identifier outside D-102. It does not amend D-102. It does not use Rosetta. It does not invent an occupancy leftover-join. leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded on G03 occupancy is empty. It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not close OBL-2. It does not execute G03. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of G03 fixture authoring by naming initial states drawn from live G03 v4 exactByteIntent and noLoadProtocol, with NOT-AUTHORED markers attached to those named states.
